tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: color-secure-green
tokens.usage: Trust, verification, approved status, safety signal. Used as text on `.nav-link.secure`, `.stat-trend`, `.card-badge`. 1.9:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-alert-amber
tokens.usage: Caution, pending status, attention required, warning. Used as border on `.stat-card:nth-child(3)`.

tokens.name: color-deep-navy

tokens.name: color-fingerprint-gray

tokens.name: color-tech-blue

tokens.name: color-carbon
tokens.usage: Strong security, data protection, authority. Used as text on `body`. 14.0:1 on `page-bg`.
